name: Wakame
description: Soft green seaweed that swells when soaked — the seaweed in miso soup.

tcm.note: Read with the seaweeds, which are cold and soften hardness in TCM.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; salty and cooling like the other sea vegetables.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with kelp and nori.

histamine.note: Dried sea vegetable, like nori and kombu.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
